lines.zh: 箱子长出腿，一步步挪过来
lines.en: The chest grows legs and shuffles over.

lines.zh: 我的锁扣一张一合，像在喘
lines.en: My latch opens and closes like breathing.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里走，颜色像腐土
lines.en: I walk out of shadow, the color of rot.

lines.zh: 四条腿很短，走起来很沉
lines.en: Four short legs, walking heavy.

lines.zh: 我的箱盖裂开，里面全是牙
lines.en: My lid splits; teeth inside.
The grass blackens where I pass.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地靠近，箱子跟着晃
lines.en: I hop closer, and the chest rocks.

lines.zh: 木板的缝里渗出紫色的雾
lines.en: Purple mist seeps from the board seams.

lines.zh: 我的舌头从锁孔里伸出来
lines.en: My tongue slips out through the keyhole.

lines.zh: 我不是箱子，我只是长得像
lines.en: I am no chest; I only look like one.

lines.zh: 我踩在腐土上，声音很闷
lines.en: I tread rotten soil with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 我一步步来，你迟早会开我
lines.en: I close in; sooner or later you will open me.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，摆成一个箱子的样子
lines.en: I settle into the shape of a chest.

lines.zh: 我的盖微微开着，露出一点黑
lines.en: My lid sits ajar, showing a sliver of black.
I wait for someone to open me.
My lock is a fake.
Purple veins crawl over the boards.
I smell something alive.

lines.zh: 我很沉，不动的时候就是一块木头
lines.en: Heavy as I am, still, I am only wood.
My corners have worn sharp.
I can wait a long time; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 这一带的宝箱都该提防
lines.en: Every chest in this area should be suspect.
I turn my latch toward you.

lines.zh: 你看到我了，那就不必装了
lines.en: You have seen me; no need to pretend.
My lid lifts an inch.
It is dark inside, and very full.
Think again before you reach out.

lines.zh: 再一步你就碰到我的锁。
lines.en: One step more and you'll touch my lock.
I listen to you drawing breath.
I am no ordinary chest.
My teeth grind inside the lid.

lines.zh: 你知道的，你现在知道了
lines.en: You know now; you know.

lines.zh: 我的盖子被砸得合不拢
lines.en: My lid is knocked out of line.
A board splits.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我叫起来像木头响
lines.en: I do not cry out; my cry would sound like wood.
Some of the purple mist disperses.
I retreat and readjust my shape.
The contents rattle inside.
These teeth of mine can still bite.

lines.zh: 这个箱子里可没有宝物
lines.en: There is no treasure in this chest.
One of my legs is bent.

lines.zh: 你打得开我，却拿不走里面的东西
lines.en: You can open me, but you cannot take what is inside.

lines.zh: 你想打开我，那就是我等的
lines.en: You want to open me; that is what I waited for.
Come closer to me.

lines.zh: 我里面装的东西，你猜不到
lines.en: You cannot guess what I hold.
Put your hand on my lid.

lines.zh: 你的手指已经碰到锁扣了
lines.en: Your fingers have touched the latch.
Press down a little more.
Half a step closer and I open.

lines.zh: 你闻不到里面的味道吗
lines.en: Can you not smell what is inside?
Do not retreat; it is only a chest.
There, I have opened.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的盖子震开了
lines.en: You slam into me and my lid rattles open.
I do not give ground; I bite instead.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我歪了一角
lines.en: That knocked one corner crooked.
My boards are harder than stone.
The purple mist scatters.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞开我的锁扣。
lines.en: Your knee knocks my latch open.
My legs grip the ground, steady.
You were not bitten; count yourself lucky.
I rearrange into chest shape again.
If you want me open, open me directly.
Mimics do not come in pairs.

lines.zh: 我们这一种，只认得自己的箱子样
lines.en: Our kind only know their own chest shape.

lines.zh: 遇到同类，会先比一比谁更像
lines.en: Meeting kin, we compare which looks more convincing.

lines.zh: 我骗过很多人，不需要同伴
lines.en: I have fooled many; I need no partner.

lines.zh: 两具箱子放在一起，太显眼
lines.en: Two chests together draw attention.
I do not share a meal.
Every chest here is me.
I hide deeper than my kin.
When someone comes to open us, then we see.

lines.zh: 我一直在等，等了很多年
lines.en: I have waited many years.
My tongue curls out and takes it, quickly.
This has gone into my chest.
I taste it; it is iron.

lines.zh: 里面装了这个，更像真的了
lines.en: With this inside, I look more genuine.

lines.zh: 我把它压在一堆东西下面
lines.en: I press it under a heap of things.
I never take things with hands.

lines.zh: 我听见它在箱底滚了一圈。
lines.en: The sound rolls around my bottom boards.

lines.zh: 我不需要它，但我要收着
lines.en: I do not need it, but I keep it.
The fuller the chest, the more it looks like treasure.

lines.zh: 你要是想拿回去，就伸手
lines.en: If you want it back, reach in.
Someone has come near my chest.

lines.zh: 你伸手的那个姿势，我熟
lines.en: I know that reaching gesture.

lines.zh: 我保持不动，等你再近一步
lines.en: I hold still; one more step from you.
At this distance, one hop.

lines.zh: 紫色从我的缝里渗出来
lines.en: Purple seeps from my seams.

lines.zh: 我等你的手伸过来，很久了。
lines.en: You've finally reached out your hand.
Your hand is frozen mid-air; good.
I am not what you think.
My latch has sprung open.
Now it is my turn to move.
I extend my legs.
You cannot back away now.

lines.zh: 我的舌头已经抵住牙关。
lines.en: My tongue is already behind my teeth.
The grass changes color under me.

lines.zh: 我的牙全露出来，收不回去。
lines.en: All my teeth are out. I can't close again.

lines.zh: 这种惊讶，我见过很多次
lines.en: I have seen that surprise many times.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我叫会破坏效果
lines.en: I do not roar; it would ruin the effect.
Come in; do not be shy.
Every hop thickens the purple mist.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪，我的箱子就跟到哪
lines.en: Wherever you run, the chest follows.
I am not fast, but you cannot shake me.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾把你围起来了
lines.en: Purple mist closes around you.

lines.zh: 我又装作箱子，等你回头
lines.en: I pretend to be a chest again, for when you look back.
My teeth keep grinding.
I can hear you hesitating.

lines.zh: 这一带的箱子你都该怀疑
lines.en: You should suspect every chest here.
I have moved ahead of you.

lines.zh: 你把背对着我，这很危险
lines.en: Turning your back to me is dangerous.
I am patient; a little hunger is fine.

lines.zh: 我算你还有几步到门口
lines.en: I count your steps to the doorway.
The rotten ground here helps me.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，没有箱子可躲
lines.en: You back to the corner; no chest to hide in.
I leap again.
For the last stretch, I stop pretending.
My bottom boards grind on stone.
My shadow covers you.
I see your hands shaking.
I am right behind you.
The lid opens and all the teeth come out.
I slam the whole chest forward.
My tongue hooks your leg.
That knocked you backward.

lines.zh: 里面的东西全撒出来了
lines.en: Everything inside spills out.
I bite and do not let go.
My corner strikes you.
Purple mist fills your face.
You pull back, and I close my lid.
My lid shuts and springs open again.

lines.zh: 咬完我把盖合好，装回箱子
lines.en: After biting, I close up and pretend to be a chest again.

lines.zh: 这一下很沉，箱子本来就很重
lines.en: That was heavy; chests are heavy by nature.
My corner pins you to the stone.

lines.zh: 我的木板裂了一道，但还咬得住
lines.en: A board cracked, but I can still bite.
Something is stuck between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我原地跳了一下，整个箱子砸下来
lines.en: I leap in place and the chest comes down.
Come closer and I open.
You will remember that sound.
I retreat and arrange myself again.

lines.zh: 宝箱是给贪心的人准备的
lines.en: Chests are made for the greedy.

lines.zh: 地上多了一个看起来能开的箱子
lines.en: A chest appears that looks like it can be opened.

lines.zh: 我从腐土里升出来，带着紫色的雾
lines.en: I rise from the rot with purple mist.
This body does not look alive.

lines.zh: 我把腿收起来，先装成箱子
lines.en: I fold my legs and pretend to be a chest.
The ground around me darkens.

lines.zh: 我选了一处人常走的岔路
lines.en: I chose a fork people often take.
Rust still hangs on my latch.

lines.zh: 没有人会想到箱子会动
lines.en: No one suspects a chest will move.

lines.zh: 我不在自然生成的名单里
lines.en: I am not on any natural spawn list.
I was placed here.
I wait for the first one to come close.

lines.zh: 盖子合上，一点缝都不留
lines.en: The lid shuts with no gap at all.
A board catches fire; I leap away.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，箱子散了半开
lines.en: I fall from height and burst half open.

lines.zh: 水灌进箱子，里面的东西都泡了
lines.en: Water floods the chest and soaks everything.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的盖子掀掉了
lines.en: The blast tears my lid off.
An arrow sticks in my boards.

lines.zh: 那股力让我的锁扣自己弹开
lines.en: That force springs my latch open.
I have not had a meal in ages.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的铁锁上，火星四溅
lines.en: Lightning hits my iron lock; sparks fly.
There is nothing beneath the chest.
